summary: Indian stocks look set for a flat-to-muted open on Thursday after a strong post-holiday rally, with action likely to centre on results winners and stocks joining MSCI's index.

detail.leaders: MSCI additions LIC, Coforge, Adani Green and Meesho; Tata Power and Hindustan Copper on results
detail.laggards: PI Industries after its MSCI exit
detail.tone: A forward-looking pre-open read. The signals point to a quieter start than Wednesday's surge, with the market likely to consolidate rather than extend sharply, despite the overnight US tech rally.
watch: Whether the market holds its gains after the eight-session run
